name: Baccaurea macrocarpa
tagline: A rare tropical rainforest fruit tree valued for its nutritious and medicinal fruit.
description: Baccaurea macrocarpa, commonly known as Tampoi, is a tropical fruit tree native to Southeast Asia. It is widely found in regions of Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand. The tree produces edible antioxidant-rich fruits that are appreciated for their sweet and slightly tangy taste. Traditionally, different parts of the plant have been used in folk medicine for digestive support and for minor skin-related conditions.
origin: Tropical Southeast Asia, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand
medical: Antioxidant-rich, digestive aid, anti-inflammatory properties. Folk medicine reports topical use for minor swelling or skin issues.

name: Banana Grove
tagline: A versatile fruit plant valued for nourishment, offering, and natural farm utility.
description: Grown in high-density sectors of our fields, these groves cycle active biomass resources across our soils while producing clean yields of nutrient-dense offerings year-round.
medical: Highly cooling configuration that pacifies Vata and Pitta conditions. The fully ripe fruit restores electrolytic structural integrity to systemic tissue, while green structures are utilized within traditional recipes as astringents to manage gut irritation.
